cards.text: Pull up a chair, friend, because the Gospel of Mark opens with good news, and it says so in its very first line: "This is the beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God." No warm-up, no small talk, straight to it. I once spent ten minutes just deciding which oven to preheat.
Then Mark's gospel reaches back to words written in Isaiah the prophet. And I'm leaning in, because somebody's getting sent ahead.

cards.question: In those words from Isaiah, a messenger gets sent on ahead. What is the messenger sent to do?
Isaiah's words keep going, with a voice calling out in the wilderness to get ready for the Lord. True or false: the voice calls for straight paths for Him.

cards.text: And then, out in that wilderness, John the Baptist appears, and the man is preaching.

cards.question: Out in the wilderness, what is John preaching?

answers.text: A baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins
A new temple for the people of God to build
A tax to rebuild the walls around Jerusalem

cards.text: And people COME, from all of Jerusalem and the countryside of Judea, and John baptizes them in the Jordan River. I can't get a baker across the kitchen for a warm batch, and this man pulls a whole city out into the wilderness!

cards.question: The people John baptizes in the Jordan don't confess their sins.

cards.text: John wears camel's hair, with a leather belt around his waist. Everything about this man says wilderness, right down to his menu.

cards.question: What does John eat out there in the wilderness?

cards.text: Then John tells them who's coming next. Someone after him, and more powerful than he is.

cards.question: John says One more powerful than he is will come after him. How does John compare himself to that One?

answers.text: Not worthy to untie His sandals
Chosen to carry His royal crown
Sent to stand at His right hand

cards.question: John says he baptizes the people with ___.

cards.text: Then John says the One coming after him will baptize them with the Holy Spirit. Friend, that is a WHOLE other level.
In those days, Jesus comes from Nazareth in Galilee. And He comes to the Jordan, where John is.

cards.question: When Jesus comes to the Jordan, John sends Him away without baptizing Him.

cards.text: As soon as Jesus comes up out of the water, He sees the heavens breaking open. I spent years in the back of a junk drawer getting one thin slice of kitchen light whenever it opened, and here the HEAVENS break open!

cards.question: As the heavens break open over Jesus, what does He see descending on Him?

cards.text: The Spirit comes down on Him like a dove. Then a voice comes from heaven.

cards.question: The voice from heaven calls Jesus His beloved Son.

cards.text: The voice from heaven says, "You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased." And then at once, the Spirit drives Jesus away.

cards.question: Right after His baptism, the Spirit drives Jesus into the ___.

cards.text: Jesus is out there a long time, being tempted by Satan.

cards.question: Jesus is out in the wilderness for ___ days, being tempted by Satan.

cards.text: Forty days, out there with the wild animals. Friend, I live out here alone on this cookie planet, and the wildest thing I've got for company is my oven timer.

cards.question: Jesus is out in the wilderness with the wild animals, and angels are there too. What do the angels do?
